status: mathematical address capacity, not realized biological growth

definition.omega: formal limit as generation -> infinity, never an instantiated finite grid

semantics.dot_count: addressing order / number of independent axes
semantics.occupied_nodes: a separate sparse value; must not be inferred from address capacity
semantics.cell_form: () [] {} glyph states remain independent of geometry
semantics.lineage: child generation preserves explicit parent address; coordinate scaling alone is not provenance

promotion.name: eat nine / retain one seed
promotion.definition: A rank-g unit can be promoted to rank g+1 by aggregating ten rank-g equivalent units: self plus nine peers
promotion.mass_or_count_accounting: 10 rank-g units become one rank-(g+1) aggregate; number of underlying rank-0 units is conserved if no losses
promotion.address_interpretation: 10x10 at generation 1 is a power-capacity address envelope of 100 positions, not 100 physical units created from ten
promotion.warning: Eating is a symbolic merge operator; energy balance, physical mass, real cellular digestion and biological viability are not specified.
